newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts aspire to 115-00 if 114-23 breaks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts aspire to 115-00 if 114-23 breaks.

text.p: June gilt futures traded on LIFFE have their sights set on 115-00 and higher on Friday if they can break above the 114-20/23 highs set earlier in the week, technical analysts said.
The June contract has been trading in a sideways range since May 9, after shooting up from the 111-00 area in early May.

"It's forming a bull flag rather than a topping pattern," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "An extension of that should take the market to 115-00 and then 115-16/23."
June gilt futures closed at 114-17 on Thursday.
He said the contract was still in a firm bull trend, despite the speed of the recent upward move.
He said although the momentum indicators had tapered off a bit, and Relative Strength Indices were around overbought territory, there was nothing to worry him yet.
The 14-day RSI was at 77 percent by 0807 GMT. A reading of 70 percent can indicate the market is overbought.
On the downside, a break below Monday's low of 113-29 and the May 6 high at 113-24 could mean the contract is in trouble.
"Then things could be tricky," Celaya said. "It could correct to 113-00, 112-16."
Analysts at Chase said the contract should exceed the 114-24 cycle high established last week, suggesting a test of the upper boundary of the ascending trend channel which comes in at 114-29.
They said a break there would open upside potential to 117-23/25 in the medium term.
At the short end, September short sterling futures were up one basis point at 93.28.
